- Send reissued copies of outstanding invoices dated prior to 2027-03-31 showing the new bill-to name for our ledger.
- Change remit instructions to our new EUR IBAN (DE89 3704 0044 0532 0130 00) for SEPA; bank name National Bank Europe.

I've attached our signed billing change form and a PDF with the new entity details. Please confirm what Redwood needs from our side to get the reissue + remit change completed, and an ETA for the reissued invoices so we can schedule payment runs.

Hi Amina — thanks for the heads up and the form.

We can handle the legal-name update and reissue outstanding invoices, and we'll switch the remit instructions for new invoices. To make sure we meet your payment run I need the following from you:

1) Signed billing-change PDF (received) — thanks.
2) Confirmation of the billing contact email for purchase order attachments (we currently have finance@helix-group.com listed).
3) Copy of a bank confirmation (masked) showing the IBAN and beneficiary name, or a statement from National Bank confirming the account is held by Helix Holdings EU SARL (for our anti-fraud/KYC).
4) Clarify whether retrospective reissues should show the original invoice dates or new reissue dates (Helix prefers original date + ‘reissued for entity change’ note; confirm).

Internal owners: looping in Connor from Collections and Marissa from Billing to coordinate reissue and posting. Connor — can you review the attached checklist and confirm timeline for reissuing three outstanding invoices (total EUR 142,800)? I propose we aim to send reissued PDFs by Thu 29 Apr to give Helix a week to process payment. If Helix provides bank confirmation sooner we can expedite to next-week processing.

I've attached our internal invoice reissue checklist for reference.

Attachments: Redwood-Invoice-Reissue-Checklist.pdf (application/pdf, 36KB)

Thanks — Grace
